Editor Anup Sagar Skill — Initial Release

- Launches AI-powered video editing: upload raw footage, describe desired edits, and receive polished 1080p MP4 files.
- Supports major video formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB).
- Automates user setup: obtains NEMO_TOKEN and creates editing sessions.
- Clear commands for exporting videos, checking credits, and managing timeline state.
- Fast cloud rendering pipeline: typical edits process in 30–90 seconds.
- Comprehensive error handling, session management, and workflow tips included.
